name: Inosaki Mako
source:
She is a sports girl who participates in various athletic teams as a helper. She has a manly demeanor and a blunt, straightforward personality, but on the inside she is very girly and loves cute things, and enjoys cooking and handicrafts. 

She has a maidenly side and turns bright red and goes silent when she is treated like a girl, as if she thinks it doesn't suit her.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/index.htmll]official website[/url]]
